new.s: Who among the following Ananda Gotra kings issued the Mattepadu plates and patronised Buddhism?
new.x: Damodara Varma of the Anandagotrikas issued the Mattepadu plates; he patronised Buddhism though he is also credited with Hiranyagarbha danam.
new.angle: U0055 PYQ ycd8bfad98f9 Anandagotrika king -> act/record

new.s: Which plates record the Hiranyagarbha danam performed by Atti Varma of the Ananda gotra?
new.x: The Gorantla plates record that Atti Varma (Attivarman) of the Ananda gotra performed Hiranyagarbha danam.
new.angle: U0055 PYQ ycd8bfad98f9 Anandagotrika king -> act/record

new.s: Which was the capital of the Ikshvakus?
new.x: Vijayapuri (Nagarjunakonda) was the Ikshvaku capital; Vengi was the Salankayana capital.

new.s: Which is regarded as the earliest copperplate grant in Andhra?
o: Chikkulla plates of Vikramendra Varma II
Ipur plates of Madhava Varma I
new.x: The Prakrit Kondamudi plates of the Brihatphalayana king Jayavarma, issued from Kuduru, are the earliest copperplate grant in Andhra.

new.s: Whose reign is regarded as the golden age of the Vishnukundins?
new.x: Madhava Varma II was the greatest Vishnukundin ruler; his reign is called the golden age and saw a Vedic revival.

new.s:
Arrange the following Vishnukundin rulers in chronological order:

a. Govinda Varma I

b. Indravarma

c. Madhava Varma II

d. Madhava Varma I
new.x: The order is Indravarma (founder), Madhava Varma I, Govinda Varma I and then Madhava Varma II.
new.angle: U0055 #3 rulers chronological order (PYQ y190b0e8f62d sequence form)

new.s: Which was the medium of instruction in the Ghatikas under the Vishnukundins?
new.x: Ghatikas were higher colleges of Sanskrit and Vedic learning, and Sanskrit was the teaching language.
new.angle: U0056 PYQ yab2399f9a33 college -> medium of instruction

new.s: Which of the following symbols is found on Vishnukundin coins?
new.x: Vishnukundin coins bear symbols such as the lion, Nandi, ship, conch and trishula; the tiger and fish are Chola and Pandya emblems.

new.s: To whom was the Vishnukundin Mutukali agrahara granted?
new.x: The Mutukali grant gave an agrahara to Indravarma and Agnivarma; the Ipur plates name Agnisarma and Easwarasarma.

new.s: Which cave site in Andhra Pradesh has eight rock-cut caves, all dedicated to Shiva?
new.x: Bhairavakonda has eight rock-cut caves, all dedicated to Shiva, and was a centre of the Kapalika sect.

new.s:
Match the following:

List-I (Cave)
a. Undavalli
b. Mogalrajapuram
c. Bhairavakonda

List-II (Feature)
1. Eight caves

new.x: Undavalli has four storeys, Mogalrajapuram has five caves and Bhairavakonda has eight caves.

new.s: In which hill range do the Bhairavakonda caves lie?
new.x: The Bhairavakonda caves lie in the Nallamala hills on the Nellore-Prakasam border.

new.s: Which type of capitals are found on the lion-based pillars of the Bhairavakonda caves?
new.x: The Bhairavakonda pillars are lion-based with kumbha (pot) capitals.

new.s: Who is the author of the Gathasaptasati, the main literary source for Satavahana society?
new.x: The Gathasaptasati (Gaha Sattasai) of King Hala is the main literary source of Satavahana social life.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Gathasaptasati:
1. It begins with a prayer to Shiva (Pasupati).
2. It is the main literary source of Satavahana society.
3. It was composed in Sanskrit.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The Gathasaptasati opens with a prayer to Shiva (Pasupati) and is the main source for Satavahana society, but it is in Maharashtri Prakrit, not Sanskrit.
new.angle: U0058 PYQ y05c09fd08f6 opening prayer + source angle

new.s: What was the 'Maiputa' used by dancers in the Satavahana period?
new.x: The Maiputa used by dancers was Kusuma Lepanam.

new.s: What were the assemblies of Tamil poets held under Pandya patronage called?
new.x: Sangam means a conference of poets or forum of scholars; all three were held under Pandya patronage.
new.angle: U0059 PYQ y8e3ce7da9be meaning of Sangam

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Sangam literature:
1. It was composed in old Tamil.
2. It has about 2,400 poems, including some by women poets.
3. It has no reference to material culture.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Sangam poems are in old Tamil and number about 2,400, some by women; they are rich in material culture, so statement 3 is wrong.

new.s: By what name did Arab writers refer to the Pandya kingdom?
new.x: Arab writers called the Pandya kingdom Ma'bar.

new.s: Which was the capital of the Chera kingdom in the Sangam age?
new.x: The Chera capital was Vanji (Karur/Karuvur); Madurai was Pandya and Uraiyur Chola.

new.s: In which period were the colleges at Ennayiram and Tribhuvani in South Arcot famous as Vedic colleges?
new.x: Ennayiram and Tribhuvani in South Arcot were Vedic colleges of the later Chola period.

new.s: Which of the following were Vedic colleges of the later Chola period?
new.x: Ennayiram and Tribhuvani in South Arcot were Vedic colleges of the later Chola period; Amaravati and Vengi were Vishnukundin Ghatikas.

new.s: In the Sangam age, what did the terms Ko, Kon, Mannan and Vendan mean?
new.x: Ko, Kon, Mannan and Vendan were all words for the king.
